2014_spells.time-slipp.description: You briefly slow the time around a willing creature you touch. The creature can use its reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. At 5th level, the creature can move up to 15 feet. At 11th level, the creature can move up to 20 feet. At 17th level, the creature can move up to 25 feet.
2014_spells.time-slipp.effectSummary: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.time-slipp.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you briefly slow the time around a willing creature you touch. The creature can use its reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; At 5th level, the creature can move up to 15 feet; At 5th level, the creature can move up to 15 feet; At 11th level, the creature can move up to 20 feet; At 17th level, the creature can move up to 25 feet. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
